def test_user_registration_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer = resp.json()
    assert customer.get("username") == username

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_user_add_address_and_card():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password123",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    address_data = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert address_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address = resp.json()
    assert address.get("city") == "London"
    assert address.get("id") == address_id

    card_data = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card = resp.json()
    assert card.get("id") == card_id
    assert card.get("longNum").endswith("3456")
    assert "*" in card.get("longNum")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in addresses)

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in addresses)

def test_catalogue_endpoints():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(socks, list)
    if not socks:
        pytest.skip("No socks in catalogue")

    sock_id = socks[0].get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    sock = resp.json()
    assert sock.get("id") == sock_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags = resp.json().get("tags", [])
    assert isinstance(tags, list)

    if tags:
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/size?tags={tags[0]}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        assert "size" in resp.json()

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/invalid-id-12345"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_add_get_delete_items():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password123",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    if not socks:
        pytest.skip("No socks in catalogue")
    item_id = socks[0].get("id")
    unit_price = socks[0].get("price")

    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    added_item = resp.json()
    assert added_item.get("itemId") == item_id
    assert added_item.get("quantity") == 2

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0].get("itemId") == item_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("itemId") == item_id

    update_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 5,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=update_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("quantity") == 5

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_carts_merge():
    session_id = f"session_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    customer_id = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    if not socks:
        pytest.skip("No socks in catalogue")
    item_id = socks[0].get("id")
    unit_price = socks[0].get("price")

    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("itemId") == item_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId=invalid_session"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_payment_authorize_and_get():
    order_id, _ = setup_order()

    payment_req = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",
            "country": "UK",
            "number": "10",
            "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
            "street": "Downing Street"
        },
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {
            "ccv": "123",
            "expires": "12/25",
            "longNum": "1234567890123456"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "Test",
            "lastName": "User"
        },
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth.get("authorised") is True
    assert auth.get("orderId") == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) >= 1
    assert auths[-1].get("authorised") is True

    payment_req["amount"] = 150.0
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth_declined = resp.json()
    assert auth_declined.get("authorised") is False

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) >= 2
    assert auths[-1].get("authorised") is False
